name: local-verify-kit
author: YIOYIOIOI
description: Modular, local-first verification skills for AI coding agents: E2E smoke testing, diff-triggered reliability checklists, base-branch isolated code review, and git-history retrospectives with cross-agent delegation (Codex, Claude, or subagents).
suggestedPrompts: Use verify-init to inspect this repo and scaffold a stress-tested project verify skill
Use verify-run to run local fast checks and end-to-end smoke verification (or delegate to codex)
Use isolated-review to review this branch against base-branch REVIEW.md with an independent agent
